primary_selection: four policy subjects leave-one-subject-out; maximum pooled path ACC, then minimum Brier, then candidate order
secondary_selection: minimum grouped-crossfit Brier; eligible only if CV correct count loses at most one case versus identity; ties prefer identity
selective_no_valid_threshold: all uncertain; no claimed precision gain
learning: StandardScaler and unbalanced LogisticRegression fitted only on policy training subjects; prior-only numeric fallback if a training split has one class
legacy_numeric_selection_caveat: Frozen numerical candidate was previously selected on all four policy subjects; the new fusion CV is conditional on that prior selection, not a re-nested numerical model search
uncertainty: 2000 paired subject-cluster bootstrap replicates, seed2026, percentile 95% intervals; exploratory, already examined outer dataset
uncertainty_flags: record only; never treated as calibrated reliability or used to claim a confidence gain
